verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs clearly cover the undo half of the story: you can retract a message right after sending by clicking Undo, with a configurable cancellation period of 5, 10, 20, or 30 seconds. Nothing in the pack documents scheduling an email to send later. Snooze applies only to incoming mail and the offline Outbox only sends on reconnect, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit. missing for 10: any documented schedule-send capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of undo send.
